content.text: I'm trying to define a sentinel value in typescript and obviously doing it wrong. Can you look at uncommitted changes?

input.command: cd /Users/maparent/OpenSource/discourse-graph/apps/website && sed -n 105,260p app/utils/conversion/jsonld.ts; npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | head -30
input.description: Read the asJsonLD function and type-check the website app

content.text:
The problem is `new Object()`: its type is `Object`, which is not a singleton type, so `typeof CONTENT_PAGE_MARKER` is just `Object`. Almost anything is assignable to `Object`, so `content === CONTENT_PAGE_MARKER` cannot narrow, and in the `else if` branch `content` is still `Content | Object`.

`tsc` reports three errors, all in `asJsonLD` in `app/utils/conversion/jsonld.ts`: `content.text` (line 214) and `content.last_modified` (lines 242 and 243).

I have not edited anything. The fix has two parts:

1. **Use a unique symbol as the sentinel.** A `const` initialised with `Symbol()` gets a `unique symbol` type, which `===` does narrow on:

   ```ts
   export const CONTENT_PAGE_MARKER = Symbol("content-page");
   ```

   The `content?: Content | typeof CONTENT_PAGE_MARKER` annotation stays as it is, and this fixes line 214.

2. **Guard the `last_modified` check further down.** A symbol is truthy, so `if (content && ...)` at line 242 still lets the marker through. Either test it explicitly:

   ```ts
   if (
     content &&
     content !== CONTENT_PAGE_MARKER &&
     content.last_modified > lastModified
   )
   ```

   or narrow once before the `if` chain and use the narrowed value in both the `else if` branch and the `last_modified` check:

   ```ts
   const pageContent = content === CONTENT_PAGE_MARKER ? undefined : content;
   ```

The route file needs no change. Say the word if you want me to apply this and rerun `tsc`.
